name: create_go_generic_lru_cache
description: Creates a generic Go LRU cache (capacity eviction by recency) used by an existing MemoService (cross-file)
prompts: cache_service.go already exists and uses a generic cache via NewLRU[int, int](2), then .Get(key) (returning (V, bool)), .Put(key, val), and .Len(). Create lru.go defining a generic type LRU[K comparable, V any] plus NewLRU[K comparable, V any](capacity int) *LRU[K, V] that implements a least-recently-used cache: Get returns the value and true if present (and counts as a use), Put inserts/updates, Len returns the current size, and when inserting a new key would exceed capacity the LEAST-recently-used entry (least-recently Get or Put) is evicted. A Get must refresh recency so it is not the next to be evicted. Do not modify cache_service.go.
